lessons.trigger_condition: The V400 portfolio lacked an independent official card/product release surface, while its dashboard integration also attempted a cache-label bump that conflicted with preserved v276 runtime, dock and UI coherence contracts.
lessons.prevention_rule: Score card-release coverage only from local releases.json freshness, official-source, verification, region and game evidence; treat missing evidence as revalidation demand; never invent release facts; and keep the service-worker cache identifier at tcg-v276-network-first-runtime unless the ABI and every preserved compatibility contract are migrated together.
validation_required: V400 exposes five evidence-governed surfaces including card_release
card_release uses KR/JP/US and Pokemon/One Piece/Naruto coverage with official-source and recent-verification evidence
missing card-release evidence is fail-closed and prioritizes bounded revalidation
release facts, prices and grades are never invented
runtime, alignment, exhaustive and integrity guards pass
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V394 binds verified operational release coverage and the cache ABI repair. It does not claim physical-device execution, invent release/price/grade facts, widen trust, bypass CI, execute arbitrary commands, or permit direct Git/main writes.
